categories.main_business_segments: SK D&D Co., Ltd. operates primarily in real estate development and renewable energy development. Its business segments include real estate development and operation (offices, residential, knowledge industry centers, hotels, commercial facilities, logistics centers), renewable energy projects (solar, wind, fuel cells), ESS (Energy Storage System) business, and furniture business through subsidiaries. The company also engages in real estate investment management and property management services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes comprehensive project management capabilities including site acquisition, product planning, permitting, scheduling, budgeting, financing, marketing, and risk management. In renewable energy, it covers the full value chain from development, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction), to O&M (Operation & Maintenance) for solar, wind, and fuel cell power plants. ESS business integrates advanced energy management and real-time power usage analysis technologies. The furniture segment imports and distributes premium European furniture brands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include institutional investors (REITs, funds) for real estate projects, corporate clients for renewable energy power purchase agreements (PPA) and energy storage services, and individual consumers for residential leasing and furniture sales. The company targets domestic non-residential real estate markets including offices, hotels, knowledge industry centers, logistics, and residential rental housing, as well as corporate and industrial clients for renewable energy and ESS solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea, focusing on major urban centers such as Seoul (CBD, GBD, YBD), Gyeonggi Province, and other metropolitan areas. Renewable energy projects are located nationwide, including Jeju Island and various provinces. The company also participates in offshore wind projects and has joint ventures with international partners.
categories.supply_chain_position: SK D&D operates mainly as a developer and operator in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate and renewable energy supply chains. It secures land and development rights, manages construction and development projects, and operates assets post-completion. In renewable energy, it develops, constructs, operates power plants, and provides energy management services. It also acts as an asset manager and property manager through subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company is strategically focusing on expanding its digital and proptech capabilities to enhance user experience in residential and office spaces, including developing integrated platforms and mobile applications. It is accelerating growth in renewable energy by expanding solar, wind, and fuel cell projects, and advancing power brokerage and virtual power plant (VPP) businesses. R&D efforts are concentrated in smart grid technologies and ESS optimization to improve energy efficiency and safety.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple streams: sales and leasing of developed real estate properties, service fees from property and asset management, electricity sales from renewable energy projects (including SMP and REC sales), energy storage services with shared savings models, and sales of premium furniture products. The company also earns income from equity-method investments in joint ventures and REITs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SK D&D is positioned as a leading real estate developer and renewable energy operator in South Korea, with strong capabilities in prime office development, knowledge industry centers, and renewable energy projects. It competes with other major domestic real estate developers and energy companies. Its integrated approach combining real estate and energy solutions, along with digital platform development, differentiates it from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the end of 2023, SK D&D reported total assets of approximately 2.42 trillion KRW and revenues of about 479.7 billion KRW, with operating profit of 190.4 billion KRW and net income of 103.1 billion KRW. Although revenue decreased by 14.9% compared to the previous year, operating profit and net income increased significantly due to gains from indirect real estate investments. The company maintains a debt-to-equity ratio of 218%, reflecting active financing for growth. It has a stable credit rating of A3/BBB from Korean rating agencies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SK D&D emphasizes its comprehensive development capabilities, strong project management, and diversified portfolio across real estate and renewable energy sectors. It offers user-centric space planning with innovative brands like 'Episode' for rental housing and 'Think Factory' for knowledge industry centers. The company integrates digital proptech solutions to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency. Its renewable energy business leverages full value chain expertise and advanced energy storage solutions, positioning it as a sustainable urban space and energy partner.
